name: 28HPC+ S0 real SRAM macro TT characterization
boundary: One real 256x128 SRAM macro; library-level PT, no DC gates required. TB excluded; output load 2fF/bit. No bank fabric or ICG.
limitations: Evidence enum is registry generic prelayout circuit category, not a claim DC was run.
Local staging is not canonical registry publication.

source.binding: Immutable remote source snapshots and SHA256 in delivery JSON
